resources.string: Requests a zero battery charging-current limit without suspending USB input. This does not confirm hardware battery isolation. Thermal protections remain enabled.
Zero charging-current limit confirmed by firmware
Restoration pending — normal charging is not confirmed. Keep the charger connected and retry restoring.
Control unavailable. Requires the matching kernel and ROM permissions; an unreadable state does not mean off.

The operation could not be confirmed. Check the state above. To enable, connect a charger with battery at 30–95%, temperature at 20–40 °C and health reported as good. The firmware may not support pausing.

Experimental: verify the current and battery level with a wall charger. The battery may still supply power if USB input is insufficient.

The kernel checks every 5 seconds while awake and attempts to restore the previous limit after 30 minutes, unplugging, unsafe readings or a charging-service restart. It does not hold the phone awake; checks resume after sleep. Other charging controls take precedence.

Not saved across boots. Restore before rebooting or flashing; forced resets and firmware failures can prevent restoration. Stop testing if charging fails to resume.

Values are reported by Android and depend on driver support. Positive current means charging; negative current means discharging. Remaining charge is not the battery\'s full capacity. Health is the status reported by Android, not a measurement of battery wear.
